The '''Raxus Sewer System''' was a massive sewer located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. Researchers with [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] were unsure of the [[Species/Legends|species]] that created the system, but believed that it was thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old and was originally used to collect pools of waste for recycling.<ref name="Raxus Prime">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021024raxus|text=Raxus Prime}}</ref>
